Name: FAST FAST LASER LASER
Overview:
FAST FAST LASER LASER is the first great 4-player, top-down, competitive multiplayer game since Bomberman.

In combat, you have two weapons: a laser-blasting pistol and a plasma sword. Players can shoot lasers and tactically reflect them off of mirrors--or other lasers--to take out opponents. With the sword you can attempt to deflect incoming laser blasts with a well-timed swing.
